cautions: Source-derived dimensions are not scene acceptance or building-code certification.
Japan east wall strip has no guaranteed 0.5 m grid route; retain west public gallery as the primary route.
China main-gallery outer-west slab strip is too narrow for a normal avatar; do not count it as a required promenade.
Only ten header spans touching actual main-gallery floor are proposed for avatar collision. Retain lower doors and existing camera masonry.
All three loft intermediate south remnant guards must remain confined to non-travel spans.
Optional China bridge 0.25 m side joins are visual continuity only, not a new high-drop safety repair.
No production edits, deployment, authentication, remote push, ZIP, or Library upload is part of this audit.
